name: hex
description: Hexadecimal encoding and decoding. Converts between binary data and hexadecimal string representation.

functions.name: encode
functions.description: Encode a string to uppercase hexadecimal. Each byte becomes two hex characters (00-FF).

functions.name: encode_lower
functions.description: Encode a string to lowercase hexadecimal. Each byte becomes two hex characters (00-ff).

functions.name: decode
functions.description: Decode a hexadecimal string to bytes. Accepts both uppercase and lowercase hex digits. Invalid character pairs are skipped.

functions.name: encode_byte
functions.description: Encode a single byte (0-255) to a 2-character hex string. Values outside 0-255 are clamped using bitwise AND with 255.

functions.name: decode_byte
functions.description: Decode a 2-character hex string to a byte value. Returns -1 if the input is invalid (wrong length or invalid characters).

functions.name: is_valid
functions.description: Check if a string contains only valid hexadecimal characters (0-9, A-F, a-f) and has even length. Empty string is considered valid.

functions.name: decoded_len
functions.description: Get the length of data that would result from decoding a hex string. Returns -1 if the hex string has invalid length (odd number of characters).

returns.name: len
returns.description: Decoded length in bytes, or -1 if invalid

functions.name: encoded_len
functions.description: Get the length of hex string that would result from encoding data. Always returns input length * 2.
